ABOUT THIS PROJECT

Remembering through understanding.

An independent, AI-assisted educational reconstruction. Archive News is a fictional station. The narration follows the developing story without announcing future events. Scripts are original reconstructions, not quotations, eyewitness testimony, or a minute-by-minute transcript. This prototype includes 12 selected bulletins; the real coverage and recovery continued far beyond them.

Narration & avatars

This version uses your browser's speech voice. No avatar video is connected. Rolling reports plays each bulletin then advances chronologically. Original intervals adds quiet periods between reports. Use Next report to advance manually. The first national reports began around 8:49 a.m.; local television reported earlier.

Inspired by the real-time history format of History Live. Not affiliated with any news network, museum, or History Live.
